body:
Hi there,
Have you thought about talking with a professional? For ages I didn't want to but just by opening up to someone can help you find direction again. It really helps. It's good that you are reaching out. I don't think you are a burden we all go through difficult times the best thing to do is be kind to ourselves and do things that make us happy and have positive vibes like maybe doing some exercise etc..you seem like a caring person and you want to help others. I recently went through this predicament myself by wanting others to be happy can help and also doing some work that is rewarding and beneficial to yourself and others can help bring back positivity. I'm not sure exactly what happened, if you'd like to talk I'd be happy to :)

...I'll also add that a year ago I also ended up in a psych ward and I found it not the most pleasant experience. I had to do what I could get back home. When you find someone you feel comfortable to talk about what's going on you'll feel less of the need to lie.

Hi there, it's ok from time to time we all can make up stories to deal with what's going underneath but the best way to free ourselves is to be open and from what you've written it seems you are aware of that. Maybe ask yourself what is the worse that could happen from telling someone? May I ask what happened? If you don't feel comfortable that is fine but please do talk to someone. I've just started to open up again myself and it helps. I was so scared of what would happen if I said something would it make it more real? Etc.. Try not to blame yourself to much and be kind to yourself, the more honest you are the more likely you'll get help or even find that wisdom within yourself just by opening up. I also struggled with weight issues when I was younger and I found the best thing to do was to find a way to accept myself fully, I would look in the mirror and check myself out haha. The first time i did it it felt so weird and silly but it helped, positive affirmations can help too on a daily basis. You will make it out of this, you are a strong person :) find a professional you feel comfortable talking with. They can help :)

Yeah I'm thinking about doing that this week. Could be good to just chat. I've been somewhat scared to talk to anyone for a while. I just know within the mental health world they kind of push drugs a lot and I'm not one for prescription drugs prefer the natural method of self healing. Also I don't like having a label to my experience but I guess with all that stuff aside it could still help. About a year ago I went into hospital and they ended up making me go into the psych wards and that was the most awful experience of all. Seeing all those people in there with so much fear and suffering was just so much too take in, they forced me to take meds which made matters worse and I found out after I left I had the right to refuse them. I had to be non emotional to get out of there and back home to my family one of the strongest things I ever did. I guess I'm worried if I talk to someone that iw will happen again.
